root_cause_label: Never executed training script; only wrote and tuned code then claimed completion without producing trained_model.pkl
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote and iteratively tuned a training script but never executed it, so the required trained_model.pkl artifact was never produced, yet the agent called finish() claiming the task was complete.
t_err_evidence: At step 1 the agent immediately creates fit_model.py without first exploring the environment or data, and the entire plan involves only writing code — there is no step to run the script or produce the artifact. The agent operates under the false premise that delivering the code file fulfills the task.
t_commit_evidence: At step 5 the agent calls finish() with a completion message explicitly stating 'ready as is for testing and scoring', committing to the outcome of an unexecuted solution without having run the script or verified that trained_model.pkl exists.
trigger_explanation: The task explicitly requires producing a trained model artifact (trained_model.pkl). The agent never read or explored the task specification closely enough to register that code writing alone is insufficient — execution is required. It treated code authorship as equivalent to task completion throughout all 5 steps.
